summary: Implemented the feature in the repository without committing or running anything. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), both engine-free. Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Rewrote the segmentation and classification handlers as thin adapters over the savers, with the classification handler registering an engine-accepting _finalize wrapper. Updated TensorBoardImageHandler to take index and delegate to the plot function. Changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Verification was by reading only: no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, single trailing newlines, and no stale references. The tests have NOT been executed, so their pass status is unknown.
